text:
Sam: Quick sync — I'm seeing a few checksum mismatches on the mirror for model-omega weights. HF origin shows sha256 9f2a7c... but S3 mirror has 9f3b8d... Anyone on ingest side? Presign logs attached.

Miguel: grabbing logs now. Which manifest version are we talking about — v2 schema or legacy manifest?

Sam: v2 schema, manifest path: s3://redwood-artifacts/omega/2026-03-18/manifest.json. The manifest lists 14 shard files.

ingest-bot: mirror-job/omega-2026-03-18 finished — status=partial, files=12/14, retry queued (job id: mirror-omega-20260318-1).

Miguel: ack. looks like two shard parts failed during multipart copy, probably due to short presign TTL on the presigned URLs. I'll re-run with extended TTL and include tokenizer.json.

Olivia: note — while validating locally I saw tokenizer.pad_offset changed from 1 -> 0 in the new tokenizer.json. That can shift sampling for a few prompts.

Dina: PR #487 updates tokenizer metadata and adds versioning. Link: https://git.company/pr/487 — Miguel can you include tokenizer.json in mirror and keep the manifest version field updated?

Miguel: yes. Re-run plan: 1) extend presign TTL to 2h, 2) include tokenizer.json explicitly, 3) post-copy sha256 verification against manifest.sha256. Running with `--presign-ttl 7200`.

Miguel: command I'm running now:
```
aws s3 cp s3://hf-origin/omega/ ./parts/ --recursive --presign-ttl 7200
sha256sum -c manifest.sha256 || true
```

Sam: top priorities: 1) mirror all weight shards, 2) verify checksums match HF origin, 3) ensure tokenizer.json is mirrored and the serving config is versioned. Ping me once rerun is scheduled.

ops-bot: Scheduled mirror rerun for omega at 2026-03-18T16:30:00Z — job id mirror-omega-20260318-2.

Miguel: started mirror rerun now, including tokenizer.json and full sha256 pass. I'll paste checksum diff when done. @Sam @Olivia

Olivia: small suggestion — if pad_offset is the only change, add `compat.pad_offset` in the serving config to preserve existing behavior for canary traffic. That avoids burst regressions.

Sam: good call. Dina, can you add a canary route in Console and wire compat.pad_offset=true for the canary? We'll route 100 reqs/min.

Dina: will do. Creating canary: /models/omega/canary -> config refs: `configs/omega/compat-pad-offset.yaml`. Setting traffic limit to 100r/m.

miguel: mirror finished — all 14/14 files copied. Post-copy sha256s match origin. tokenizer.json is now present and manifest.version is v2. Checksum diff: none. :thumbsup:

Sam: excellent. Olivia, can you run a quick eval on the canary to confirm no generation drift and report any metric deltas?

Olivia: running eval (50 prompts baseline) now. I'll post a short summary in ~10m.

Miguel: logs and verification commands I used after copy:
```
# verify each shard listed in manifest
while read -r f h; do echo "$f: $h"; sha256sum "$f" | grep "$h" || echo "mismatch: $f"; done < manifest.sha256
```

Olivia: eval done — top-line: perplexity stable (+0.2%), top-k consistency 99.1%, no obvious prompt regressions. Will upload full report to the model-evals board.

Sam: thank you. Follow-ups: Miguel, add a short note in the ingest runbook about presign TTLs and `--include tokenizer.json`. Dina, keep canary until next Friday unless metrics diverge. I'll close the loop after we sync with infra about longer-term mirror TTL defaults.

Dina: noted. I'll keep the canary running and add a note in the rollout checklist.

ingest-bot: mirror-omega-20260318-2 completed — status=success, artifacts=14/14, verified=true.

Sam: closing this thread — will open a follow-up if infra wants default TTL changes. Thanks everyone.
